title: 第30章 我命由我不由天
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “阳啊，下来吧，别吊了，你都吊一个多钟头了！”“我不，我不下来！”“你下来吧，你这精神状态，班长愁的慌，班长害怕啊！来两个人，上去给他松绑......”“去去去，我不下去！”陆阳像是晒面条似的，被胶带纸捆住双手，吊在单杠上。但却因为舍不得三倍速的臂力，抓握力，耐力增长，所以迟迟不肯下来。开什么玩笑，好不容易抓着机会，能够开启三倍速，他怎么舍得就这么快结束？于是，陆阳便开启了死皮赖脸模式，不管班长怎么劝说，愣是不愿意从单杠上下来。甚至于，就连孔垄他们想要过来帮他解开胶带的束缚，陆阳都是用乱蹬腿的方式，将他们进行驱离。“完了，他吊上瘾了...”“班长，要不就让班副继续挂着吧，我看他挂着还蛮舒服...”“班长，陆阳会不会有什么受虐倾向，就喜欢这种被束缚的感觉？咱们这也没鞭子啥的，不然用武装带行吗？”周凯东捂着脸，实在是有些个哭笑不得。吊杆能坚持的时间越久，肯定是越好的，但凡事都得讲究给循序渐进。其他人都是鬼哭狼嚎，不到十分钟就求着他下来，就连孔垄也最多只是坚持了十五分钟就浑身难受。撕开胶带纸的时候，还把孔垄手上的汗毛顺带一起给扯了下来，疼的他眼泪都下来了。可唯独到了陆阳这里，却完全不是一个画风；人家是遭罪，到他这变成了享受模式？起初，周凯东以为这小子就是在逞能，还想看看他能嘴硬多久，于是便带人在边上练起了双杠。可好几组双杠臂屈伸都结束了，陆阳依旧像个没事儿人那样吊在那，甚至于嘴里叨叨叨的，还开始默背起了条令条例。这让他一度怀疑，陆阳是不是被什么脏东西给缠上了，不然怎么会这么癫？“陆阳啊，你听班长说，引体向上这东西急不得一时，你这样胳膊会脱臼的。”“班长，先前吃饭，你说要给我强化训练，加强我的体能。我现在感觉非常好，想申请多吊半个钟头，结束以后再把你们先前双杠练习全给补上！”周凯东一口老血差点没喷出来，训练偷懒的他见过太多太多，装模作样认真的也见过不少。但像陆阳这种练出感觉，想要疯狂给自已加练的，实在是不多见。也是担心吊久了会出问题，周凯东亲自上去给他松了绑。落地后，系统三倍速增长效果很快消失。随之而来的是手臂，胳膊，背部，腹部的剧烈酸痛，疼的陆阳身体都出现了一定程度僵直。看到这一幕，周凯东悬着的心也终于落下了，吊杠的副作用出现了，足够这小子喝一壶的。可偏偏就在这时，陆阳竟主动申请，想要之后每天中午晚上各吊一小时。整的周凯东直接我尼玛，答应也不是，不答应也不是。他只能宣布休息，然后借口说上厕所，赶紧溜之大吉。看着周凯东疾步离开的背影，三班新兵捧腹大笑，他们还是头回见着班长被新兵整破防的。“班副，还是你够狠，竟然想到用自虐的方式，来拿捏班长！”“自虐？没有啊？”“还没有？我们十来分钟都吃不消，你在上头挂了快一个多钟头，我们都怕你把胳膊扯断了，你不疼吗？”“其实刚开始也疼，也难受，挂着挂着好像就习惯了，我就把自已想象成一条咸鱼.......”人才！大家一致认为，陆阳肯定多少有点儿不对劲的小爱好！不然哪有人上赶着吃苦遭罪的？可谁又知道，陆阳实在太馋那三倍速的属性收益了。他甚至有种，想要重新把自已挂上去，顺带在脚底下拴个负重的疯狂想法，保不齐今回就是三点五倍收益。......借着休息喝水的工夫，三班新兵围坐一圈开始闲聊扯淡。聊的话题正是先前上思想政治课上，指导员所讲的内容。孔垄好奇询问：“那坦克入口，真就那么小吗，我这身材到底能不能挤进去？”众人望向他这体格子，纷纷摇了摇头，就连陆阳都觉得有够呛。“你就这么想，坦克驾驶舱就那么大的活动空间，你这块头哪怕是挤进去了，也活动不开。”“更何况还得装填弹药，控制方向啥的，灵活性也会受限制。”“咱们团好像是装甲部队吧？报到那天瞧见不少坦克，也不知道那大家伙里头能坐几个人，将来有没有咱们的位置？”“好像是三个。”“不对，是四个。”“新式坦克三人驾驶；老式的69坦克，59坦克，都是四个人。”如果这话是从陆阳嘴里说出来的，他们一点儿都不诧异。可偏偏开口的是丁腾飞，这就很让人觉得匪夷所思。“你还懂这个？”“我从小喜欢遥控车，家里除了雷速登，还有各种类型的坦克模型。”“所以，你是喜欢坦克，才来部队当兵的？”面对众人的好奇，丁腾飞第一次觉得难以启齿。他确实很想在下连以后，学开坦克，开战车。几十吨重的大家伙油门踩到底，在广袤的大地上驰骋，这不比骑改装电动车，骑什么重机车帅一万倍？更何况，炮管子还特么那么粗，一发炮弹下去山头都能给你炸平了，那特么多过瘾？但他却并不是奔着这些才来参军的，而是纠结一番后坦言，被家里硬逼着来的部队。可让丁腾飞没想到的是，他并非独树一帜，因为有人跟他情况差不多，也是被逼着来当兵的。“我原本想去深城打工，单位都联系好了，在富土康在里头当质检员，一个月好几千呢。”“家里死活不同意，把我身份证都给没收了，最后没办法只能来当兵了。”陆阳看着那个满脸青春痘，叫张旦的新兵，打从心里觉得他父母真是帮他选了一条对的路。性格内向的人，去到那只会变得更压抑更内向，弄不好哪天就上房顶了。陆阳看向孔垄：“你呢，你家不是开饭馆的吗，咋跑来当兵了？”孔垄扯着地上的杂草，心不在焉的说：“我不来当兵，就只能跟我爸一样，一辈子被焊死在厨房里。夏天热死人，冬天呛死人，从早到晚的一身油烟味儿。”“本来是要让我去新东方学烹饪，我死活不同意；正好我大伯当兵的，他说我身强体壮，建议我来部队锻炼锻炼，我这不就来了嘛？”“你家开饭店的，做的啥菜？”“东北菜，锅包右，猪肉炖粉条子，还带着小烧烤。”“听着不赖啊，以后有机会去东北，高低得去你家尝尝。”大家轮着说了一圈，有的是被家里逼着来当兵，有的是实在不知道该干点啥好，也有明确奔着退伍费来的。最后，众人目光落在陆阳身上：“班副，你为啥来当兵？”孔垄也好奇：“你那么喜欢看书，为啥没考上大学？”丁腾飞也将目光落在自已这个老乡身上。起初，他片面的认为陆阳是假努力，是装模作样。可相处下来也有段时间了，他发现陆阳不是装的，而是真用功。尤其是思想政治课那笔记，密密麻麻的全部都是知识点，下课后甚至被其他班长借去，给班上新兵抄了。如果是装的，那未免装的太投入了点，丝毫看不出任何麻痹松懈的样子。陆阳嘴上叼着草，一脸惆怅：“就是因为太爱看书，所以学习不好。”这话单独分开他们都能听懂，怎么合在一块反而无法理解？孔垄搞不懂：“喜欢看书，成绩不应该咔咔好吗，怎么还学不进去呢？”陆阳尴尬的说：“我喜欢看小说，白天黑夜不分入了魔的看，但就是不爱看语数外，所以高考一塌糊涂。本来是准备复读的，正好村里在征兵，干脆就来当兵了。”“所以，你真的是考砸了，才意识到学习的重要性，然后才开始奋发的？”“嗯。”“可是，我们也考砸了，甚至还有压根没去考的，大家都没你这个觉悟啊？”“不一样。”“哪儿不一样？”“阅历不一样。”丁腾飞直接翻了个白眼。你阅历再多，能有我多？好歹他之前也算是半个社会人，三教九流什么人都认识。陆阳勾勾手指，低声告诉他们一个秘密：“其实，我是重生回来的，经历过更多的事，比你们这些小屁孩儿看的更远。所以更能明白少壮不努力，老大徒伤悲这个道理。”“我这回来参军，就是要在部队里逆天改命，一步步走到最高，来一个我命由我不由天。”所有人白眼翻上天，集体切了一声。“你要是重生回来的，我们就是圣人轮回转世，左手人皇幡，右手混沌钟，背后至尊骨！”“那我是破碎虚空来的体修大能，在这游历人间，准备突破化神开宗立派，嘿嘿！”“那我就是地下世界主宰，黑白通吃，手眼通天的极品公子！”“哎哎哎，你这个不行，你这个进不来的！”面对一帮人的反驳，丁腾飞很是不服气： “凭啥，凭啥我就不行？我这起码是个正常人，没你们那么离谱！”陆阳看了他一眼：“你过不了政审。”丁腾飞满脸问号：“.......”
content_en: "Yang, come down, stop hanging, you've been hanging for more than an hour!" "I won't, I won't come down!" "Come down, your mental state makes the squad leader worried and scared! Come on, two people, go up and untie him..." "Go, go, I won't go down!" Lu Yang was hanging on the horizontal bar with his hands tied with tape as if he were drying noodles.But because he was reluctant to increase his arm strength, grip, and endurance at three times the speed, he refused to come down.Are you kidding me? He finally seized the opportunity and was able to activate triple speed. How could he be willing to end it so quickly?As a result, Lu Yang went into shameless mode. No matter how much the squad leader tried to persuade him, he was still unwilling to get off the horizontal bar.Even when Kong Long and the others wanted to come over to help him untie the tape, Lu Yang would kick them away randomly."It's over, he's addicted to hanging..." "Squad leader, why don't you let the squad deputy continue to hang? I think he feels quite comfortable hanging..." "Squad leader, does Lu Yang have some masochistic tendencies and likes the feeling of being restrained? We don't have whips here, otherwise, how about armed belts?" Zhou Kaidong covered his face, really dumbfounded.The longer the boom can last, the better, but everything must be done step by step.The others were crying and begging him to come down within ten minutes. Even Kong Long only lasted fifteen minutes at most before feeling uncomfortable all over.When he tore off the tape, he also tore off the hair on Kong Long's hands, which was so painful that he shed tears.But only when it comes to Lu Yang, his style of painting is completely different; others are suffering, but with him, it has become a mode of enjoyment?At first, Zhou Kaidong thought this kid was just showing off, and wanted to see how long he could keep his tough words, so he led someone to practice parallel bars nearby.But after several sets of parallel bar dips and extensions, Lu Yang was still hanging there like nothing had happened. He even started to recite the rules and regulations silently while mumbling.This made him wonder for a while whether Lu Yang was entangled in something dirty, otherwise why would he be so crazy?"Lu Yang, listen to the squad leader, you can't rush pull-ups. You will dislocate your arm." "Squad leader, before we had dinner, you said you would give me intensive training to strengthen my physical fitness. I feel very good now, and I would like to apply for half an hour more hanging. After that, I can make up for all your previous parallel bar exercises!" Zhou Kaidong almost spat out his blood. He had seen too many people who were lazy in training, and he had seen a lot of people who were pretending to be serious.But it is really rare to see someone like Lu Yang who has developed a feeling and wants to train himself like crazy.Also worried that something might go wrong if he was hung for a long time, Zhou Kaidong went up to untie him personally.After it was implemented, the effect of the system's triple-speed growth quickly disappeared.What followed was severe pain in his arms, arms, back, and abdomen, which made Lu Yang's body stiff to a certain extent.Seeing this scene, Zhou Kaidong's hanging heart finally dropped. The side effects of the hanging bar appeared, which was enough for this kid to drink a pot.But just at this moment, Lu Yang took the initiative to apply, wanting to hang out for an hour at noon and evening every day.The whole Zhou Kaidong is saying hello, it doesn't matter if he agrees, or he doesn't agree.He could only announce a break, then excuse himself to go to the toilet and escape quickly.Seeing Zhou Kaidong's back walking away quickly, the recruits from the third squad burst into laughter. This was the first time they saw the squad leader being defeated by the recruits."Deputy deputy, you are cruel enough, you even thought of using self-abuse to take advantage of the monitor!" "Self-abuse? No?" "Not yet? We can't stand it for more than ten minutes. You hung on it for almost an hour. We were all afraid that you would break your arm. Don't you feel pain?" "Actually, it hurt and was uncomfortable at the beginning. I seemed to get used to it, so I imagined myself as a salted fish..." Talent!Everyone agreed that Lu Yang must have some wrong little hobby!Otherwise, how could anyone go up there and endure hardships?But who knew that Lu Yang was really greedy for the triple speed attribute gain.He even had the crazy idea of ​​hanging himself up again and tying a weight under his feet. If he didn't keep it all, he would get 3.5 times the profit this time....While taking a break and drinking water, the three groups of recruits sat in a circle and started chatting.The topic of conversation was exactly what the instructor said in the previous ideological and political class.Kong Long asked curiously: "Is the entrance to the tank really that small? Can I squeeze in with my figure?" Everyone looked at his size and shook their heads. Even Lu Yang felt it was quite awkward."Just think about it this way. The tank cockpit only has such a large space for movement. Even if you squeeze in, you can't move." "Not to mention that you have to load ammunition and control the direction, so your flexibility will be limited." "Our regiment seems to be an armored force, right? I saw a lot of tanks on the day of registration, but I don't know.How many people can fit in that big thing? Will there be room for us in the future?""It seems like three." "No, it's four." "The new tanks are driven by three people;the old 69 tanks and 59 tanks are all driven by four people." If this came from Lu Yang's mouth, they were not surprised at all.But it was Ding Tengfei who spoke, which was very strange."Do you still know this?" "I have liked remote control cars since I was a child. In addition to the Raisodeng, there are various types of tank models at home." "So, you like tanks and that's why you joined the army?" Faced with everyone's curiosity, Ding Tengfei felt it was difficult to say anything for the first time.He really wanted to learn to drive tanks and chariots after joining the company.A big guy weighing dozens of tons, stepping on the accelerator and galloping across the vast land, isn't this 10,000 times more handsome than riding a modified electric bike or some other heavy motorcycle?What's more, the barrel of the cannon is so thick that a cannonball can blow you up even if it hits the top of a mountain. How enjoyable is that?But he didn't come to join the army because of this. After some struggle, he admitted that he was forced to join the army by his family.But what Ding Tengfei didn't expect was that he was not unique, because there were people in a similar situation to him who were also forced to become soldiers."I originally wanted to work in Shenzhen. I have contacted the company. I am working as a quality inspector in Futukang. It costs several thousand a month." "My family disagreed and confiscated my ID card. In the end, I had no choice but to join the army." Lu Yang looked at the pimple-covered recruit named Zhang Dan and felt from the bottom of his heart that his parents had really helped him choose the right path.Introverts will only become more depressed and introverted when they go there, and they may end up on the roof one day.Lu Yang looked at Kong Long: "What about you, your family runs a restaurant, why did you come to be a soldier?" Kong Long pulled the weeds on the ground and said absently: "If I don't come to be a soldier, I will have to be welded like my father all my life.I died in the kitchen.It was too hot in the summer and choked in the winter. It smelled like oil smoke from morning to night."I was originally supposed to go to New Oriental to learn cooking, but I didn't agree. My uncle happened to be in the army and he said I was strong.I'm strong and suggested that I come to the army to exercise.I'm here now, right?" "Your family owns a restaurant.What kind of food do you cook?" "Northeastern cuisine, stewed pork vermicelli, and a small barbecue.""If I have a chance to go to the Northeast in the future, I'd better go to your house and try it."Everyone took turns talking, some were forced by their families to become soldiers, some really didn't know what to do, and some came here clearly for the retirement pay.Finally, everyone's eyes fell on Lu Yang: "Class deputy, why did you come to be a soldier?" Kong Long was also curious: "You like reading so much, why didn't you go to college?" Ding Tengfei also turned his attention to his fellow countryman.At first, he thought one-sidedly that Lu Yang was trying hard and pretending.But after getting along with him for a while, he discovered that Lu Yang was not just pretending, but was really working hard.Especially the notes for the ideological and political class were densely packed with knowledge points. After class, they were even borrowed by other squad leaders and copied by the new recruits in the class.If he was pretending, he was pretending to be too devoted, and there was no sign of any paralysis or relaxation at all.Lu Yang had grass in his mouth and a melancholy look on his face: "It's because I love reading so much that I can't study well." They could understand these words separately, but why couldn't they understand them together?Kong Long couldn't understand: "I like reading, so my grades shouldn't be bad, so why can't I study?" Lu Yang said awkwardly: "I like reading novels, and I read them obsessively day and night, but I just don't like reading Chinese and mathematics, so I failed in the college entrance examination. I was planning to repeat the exam, but the village was recruiting soldiers, so I just joined the army.""So, you really failed in the exam before you realized the importance of studying and then started working hard?" "Yeah." "But we also failed in the exam, and some even didn't take the exam at all. No one has the same awareness as you?" "It's different." "What's the difference?" "The experience is different." Ding Tengfei rolled his eyes.No matter how much experience you have, can you have more experience than me?At any rate, he was considered half a member of society before and knew everyone from all walks of life.Lu Yang hooked his fingers and told them a secret in a low voice: "Actually, I was reborn. I have experienced more things and can see further than you little brats. So I can better understand the truth that if a young man doesn't work hard, the old man will be miserable." "When I come back to join the army, I want to change my destiny in the army against the will of nature, and step by step to the top, I will be in control of my fate." Everyone rolled their eyes to the sky and collectively let out a cry."If you are reborn, we are the reincarnation of saints, with the human emperor flag in the left hand, the chaos bell in the right hand, and the supreme bone on the back!" "Then I am a powerful physical practitioner from the Broken Void. I am traveling here in the world, preparing to break through the transformation of gods and establish a sect."Pie, hehe!""Then I am the master of the underground world, a master of black and white, and a master of all things!""Hey, you can't do this, you can't get in!"Ding Tengfei was very unconvinced by the objections of the group of people:"Why, why can't I do it? At least I am a normal person, not as outrageous as you!" Lu Yang glanced at him: "You can't pass the political review." Ding Tengfei's face was full of question marks: "..."
